中文：该源项名称写作“会心不显示”，但 ARM 指令实际把两条会心加成路径改为 100；它与 #72 共享 Wii U 路径，二者不可同时启用。 / English: The source label says critical display hidden, but its ARM instructions set two affinity-add paths to 100; it shares Wii U paths with #72 and the two cannot be enabled together.

中文：同时停止常规 HP 写回与超量伤害的致死归零写回；治疗时当前 HP 也可能保持不变。该 PPC 行为强于源 3DS 单指令补丁，3DS 版能否承受超量伤害尚未实机确认。 / English: Stops both normal HP writeback and the lethal zero-clamp for overkill damage; healing may also leave current HP unchanged. This PPC behavior is stronger than the source 3DS one-instruction patch, whose overkill behavior has not been confirmed on hardware.

中文：2026-08-07 三轮隔离对照均显示动作表现加快而普通游泳路线的实际位移不明显；0.1.21 虽补过其他水下状态，但漏掉普通游泳状态 9 中由入口共用 f31=0.5 驱动的两条最终积分。当前候选只在 0x028C7E6C/0x028C7FE0 跳过该 0.5，并补上 0x028C7B18 的 1.10→2.0 动作标量，不修改共用入口。原 3DS 项没有修改最终位移积分，因此这是 Wii U 实际移动目标的窄范围适配，仍待实机验收。关闭 #65，以相同 FPS、摇杆幅度、动作和路线分别完成至少三次基线/启用计时，并检查碰撞、上浮/下潜、冲刺和闪避过冲。 / English: Three isolated comparisons on 2026-08-07 showed faster action presentation without clear actual displacement on an ordinary swimming route. Although 0.1.21 covered other underwater states, it missed the two ordinary-swim state-9 final integrations driven by entry-shared f31=0.5. This candidate bypasses that 0.5 only at 0x028C7E6C/0x028C7FE0 and adds the missed 1.10-to-2.0 action scalar at 0x028C7B18, without changing the shared entry. Original 3DS #13 does not patch final travel integration, so this is a narrow Wii U physical-movement adaptation that still awaits gameplay acceptance. Disable #65, run at least three baseline and three enabled timings with identical FPS, stick magnitude, action, and route, and check collision, ascent/descent, dashing, and evasion for overshoot.

entries.risk: 中文：已映射自动标记核心技能检查和当前区标记判定；3DS 端另有一个 UI 虚调用点在 PPC 中没有一对一静态对应，因此小怪图标覆盖范围可能不完整。 / English: Maps the core auto-marker skill checks and current-area marker tests; one 3DS UI virtual-call site has no one-to-one static PPC counterpart, so small-monster icon coverage may be incomplete.

entries.name_zh: 剥取、采集动作与获取加快
entries.risk: 中文：精确替换共享剥取/采集动作倍率 1.3→2.0 与获取倍率 1.1→1.5；动画与实际结算可能在少数动作上不同步。 / English: Exactly redirects the shared carve/gather action multiplier 1.3→2.0 and acquisition multiplier 1.1→1.5; animation and settlement timing may diverge for a few actions.

中文：强制 JP v96 中高速收集效果 ID 的全部直接检查；#59 已直接加速剥取、采集动作与获取倍率，会掩盖本项差异。验证 #60 时请关闭 #59，并对同一采集点的完整循环计时。 / English: Forces every direct JP-v96 check for the Fast Gathering effect ID; #59 directly accelerates carving, gathering actions, and acquisition, which can mask this difference. To validate #60, disable #59 and time a complete cycle at the same gathering point.

中文：源代码把常规游戏模式的通用技能槽比较强制为相等，影响面极广；大量未勾选技能可能在第一次比较时就被判定为生效，必须单独测试。 / English: The source forces the normal-game-mode generic skill-slot comparison to equal, giving it an extremely broad blast radius; many unequipped skills may be treated as active on the first comparison, so test it in isolation.

中文：Wii U 编译结果把 #72 的核心逻辑折叠到与 #6 相同的两条会心路径；两项当前等效且不可同时启用。 / English: The Wii U build folds #72's core behavior into the same two affinity paths as #6; the two are currently equivalent and cannot be enabled together.
